jobs.title: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Reporting & Compliance Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Built by enterprise software engineers and compliance experts, we provide comprehensive Affordable Care Act (ACA) reporting and compliance services. Our team of seasoned ACA specialists, data integration experts, in\-house legal counsel, and accounting professionals delivers accurate, efficient, and trustworthy service to every client.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Manager to lead the process behind our ACA compliance deliverables. This role does not focus on finding or fixing every error directly \- rather, it focuses on catching the exceptions: patterns, inconsistencies, and edge cases that indicate a deliverable isn't ready for client review.

As the QA Manager, you will oversee the review of completed ACA Forms 1094\-C and 1095\-C work prepared by our analyst team, verify that coding and documentation meet internal standards, and ensure every deliverable is accurate, defensible, and audit\-ready before it reaches the client. This role requires technical knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements, and sharp pattern\-recognition skills.

If you enjoy digging into data to find the exception that everyone else missed, thrive under deadline pressure, and take pride in building a team that delivers accurate ACA reporting and compliance work, we look forward to hearing from you!

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review completed ACA reporting deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to client delivery
* Verify Line 14, 15, and 16 coding against plan details, employee eligibility, classification, enrollment, and affordability requirements
* Identify coding inconsistencies between current and prior filing years, and confirm that any changes are properly explained
* Run and review error reports to catch missing data, incorrect codes, or discrepancies between source files and final output
* Cross\-check questionnaire responses against how each case was actually coded and processed
* Verify that every enrolled individual is accounted for, appropriately documented, and matched with a corresponding form
* Spot\-check high\-risk scenarios, including mid\-year terminations, rehires, status changes, and multi\-FEIN employers
* Ensure findings, exceptions, and assumptions are clearly documented in tickets and supporting files
* Maintain consistent file naming, folder structure, and documentation standards across the QA process
* Provide feedback to analysts to improve accuracy and reduce recurring errors
* Collaborate with account managers and analysts to resolve open questions before deliverables are finalized

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excel Proficiency: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, INDEX / MATCH, Pivot Tables, Nested IF statements, Logical / Array formulas
* Minimum of two years hands\-on experience preparing Forms 1094 and 1095 C\-series. B series and/or ICHRA experience is a plus
* Working knowledge of ACA employer reporting requirements under IRC §6055 and §6056
* Strong understanding of Line 14/15/16 coding logic, safe harbor determinations, and affordability analysis
* High attention to detail and the ability to identify patterns or anomalies across large, multi\-source datasets
* Strong written communication skills for documenting findings, exceptions, and client\-facing notes
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, remote environment

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience leading, training, or mentoring
* Experience with quality assurance, audit, or error\-report review processes
* Exposure to HRIS/payroll data sources (e.g., ADP, Paylocity, UKG, Employee Navigator)
* Prior experience in a client\-facing or project coordination role
* Familiarity with Excel add\-ins such as Power Query that streamline data cleanup and processing.

**Interview Process**

As a remote team, we require applicants to demonstrate their ability to work independently via an Excel\-based **Technical Abilities Assessment**.

If your qualifications and experience are a match, you will receive an invitation to schedule the day and time of assessment. A packet including detailed instructions for processing and submission will then be sent for completion within 90 minutes or less.

**Why Join Us?**

* A clear path for growth, salary increases, and seasonal bonuses based on performance
* Hands\-on leadership role shaping the quality and accuracy of every client deliverable
* Work with a supportive, collaborative team of ACA specialists, data experts, and compliance professionals
* Opportunity to mentor and develop a growing analyst team
* Learn and help refine industry best practices in ACA compliance quality control
* Work environment that values precision, accountability, and getting it right the first time

**Job Details**

* Job Type: Full\-Time
* Compensation: $70,000 – $100,000
* Pay Basis: Salaried
* Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Maintenance Training Manager
jobs.description:
The Maintenance Training Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing technical training programs for aircraft maintenance personnel within the organization. This position ensures maintenance training programs meet FAA regulations, OEM standards, and internal safety and quality requirements.



The Maintenance Training Manager oversees training schedules, tracks certifications, conducts audits, evaluates training effectiveness, and works closely with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational stakeholders to ensure maintenance personnel remain proficient, compliant, and prepared to support safe air medical operations.

  


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive technical training programs for maintenance personnel.
* Develop training materials including presentations, manuals, assessments, interactive e learning modules, and other instructional resources.
* Conduct training\-needs assessments and identify skill, competency, and performance gaps.
* Deliver engaging training through classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, virtual learning, simulations, group discussions, and other instructional methods.
* Conduct audits to ensure compliance with company policies and applicable industry regulations.
* Review existing training programs and recommend enhancements to improve engagement, learning, retention, and effectiveness.
* Organize and conduct monthly induction and orientation sessions.
* Maintain current knowledge of maintenance software systems, industry best practices, software releases, and emerging technologies.
* Provide ongoing technical support and guidance to maintenance personnel regarding maintenance software systems and functionality.
* Maintain accurate training records, attendance documentation, evaluations, and training materials.
* Prepare reports regarding training outcomes, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain knowledge resources for maintenance software systems.
* Collaborate with Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, Regional Managers, software vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects requiring maintenance training expertise.

 **Minimum Required Qualifications**


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of aircraft maintenance practices, technical documentation, maintenance records, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience training, mentoring, coaching, or providing technical instruction to maintenance personnel.
* Ability to develop and deliver effective training through classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, virtual learning, and/or other instructional methods.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ability to learn and effectively utilize maintenance, training, and learning\-management software systems.
* Ability to simultaneously manage multiple training initiatives, schedules, records, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to work collaboratively across Maintenance, Quality, Safety, Operations, Human Resources, and other organizational departments.
* Ability to travel as required and work a flexible schedule when operational or training needs require.
* Valid driver's license.
* Regular and reliable attendance.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A\&P) Mechanic Certificate.
* Experience developing, implementing, or managing a formal aviation maintenance training program.
* Experience operating within an FAA Part 135 and/or Part 145 environment.
* Fixed\-wing and/or rotor\-wing aircraft maintenance experience.
* Experience developing curricula, presentations, technical manuals, assessments, e\-learning content, or other instructional materials.
* Knowledge of adult\-learning principles, instructional design, competency\-based training, and training evaluation methods.
* Experience conducting or supporting maintenance audits, quality assurance activities, regulatory inspections, or compliance reviews.
* Experience with computerized maintenance tracking systems, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and electronic training\-record systems.
* Familiarity with FAA regulations, OEM maintenance requirements, Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, and other applicable technical or regulatory guidance.
* Experience analyzing training needs, identifying competency or performance gaps, and implementing corrective training.
* Experience within air medical, EMS aviation, or another safety\-sensitive aviation environment.

This position primarily operates in an office environment with occasional exposure to hangar facilities. The position requires prolonged periods of sitting and computer work, frequent verbal and written communication, and the ability to read documents and computer screens.



The position may require lifting up to 50 pounds, navigating organizational facilities, traveling as needed, and working a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends. Occasional exposure to hazardous materials, loud noise, and extreme temperatures may occur.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:

You'll be a customer champion, driving adoption, mitigating risk, ensuring retention and finding innovative ways our platform can solve customer challenges. Join us in making a difference for our customers and Workiva!


**What You’ll Do:**

* Build strong relationships with key customer business and IT stakeholders to help guide us through their organization and introduce us to different teams
* Generate leads (CSQL) for the Workiva sales team to pursue
* Evaluate organizational inefficiencies to help customers define appropriate business outcomes
* Identify opportunities for Workiva to consult with customers on setups
* Develop relationships with the Workiva Account teams to ensure everyone is working towards the same goal and to decrease task overlap

* Ensure any customer inquiries are answered promptly and help identify the best person at Workiva to get involved when necessary
* Ensure customer awareness and issue resolution practices around ticket management when unable to resolve product issues in Workiva Platform
* Engage with onboarding team, solution architects, and any other team providing service to the customer to ensure customers expectations are being met

**What You'll Need**

Minimum Qualifications


* 4\+ years of related experience
* Bachelor’s degree \- An advanced degree will be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience supporting a SaaS product preferred
* Background in customer success, strategic account management, or sales within a business\-to\-business (B2B) sales environment
* Direct customer advocacy and engagement experience in post\-sales support, or equivalent experience in professional services, consultancy, project management, or account management functions
* Self\-motivated with strong propensity for action, results and continuous improvement and proven track record to solve technical problems
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to multitask and manage multiple processes, programs, and procedures simultaneously while working under pressure to meet deadlines

**Travel Requirements \& Working Conditions**

* Willingness to travel up to 10% for team and corporate meetings, fostering relationships and representing company interests
* Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, as we embrace flexible work arrangements

**How You’ll Be Rewarded**

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually


✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire


✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package


The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Sentant is seeking a driven and highly organized Account Manager to own the full client lifecycle — from onboarding and deployment through ongoing relationship management, retention, and growth. This role is the day\-to\-day owner of a portfolio of client accounts and the connective tissue between our clients and Sentant’s internal service teams.


### **About Sentant, LLC**


We specialize in providing comprehensive managed services that enhance your IT infrastructure, ensure compliance, and bolster security.
### **Description**


Sentant is seeking a driven and highly organized **Account Manager** to own the full client lifecycle — from onboarding and deployment through ongoing relationship management, retention, and growth. This role is the day\-to\-day owner of a portfolio of client accounts and the connective tissue between our clients and Sentant’s internal service teams.

  

The Account Manager is the hands\-on operator who makes that strategy real: standing up new clients cleanly, keeping delivery on track, and building trusted relationships that turn clients into long\-term partners. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-obsessed, and thrives in a fast\-moving, client\-facing environment.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Onboarding \& Deployment**

* Own the **end\-to\-end client onboarding process**: kickoff calls, documentation, timelines, internal coordination, and clear expectation setting.
* Drive **deployment of new clients** onto Sentant’s tools, processes, and communication channels, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks during the transition from sales to service.
* Coordinate closely with engineering, security, and helpdesk teams to stand up client environments accurately and on schedule.
* Create and maintain onboarding documentation and account records so every client starts with a clean, well\-organized foundation.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Serve as the **primary day\-to\-day point of contact** for a portfolio of clients post\-sale.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders, ensuring they feel supported, informed, and understood.
* Conduct regular client check\-ins to stay aligned on goals, priorities, and pain points, and to keep service delivery on track.
* Support and help deliver **Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)**, preparing materials that surface insights, service value, and opportunities.

**Service Delivery \& Coordination**

* Act as the client’s advocate internally, translating client needs into clear actions for Sentant’s technical and operational teams.
* Track open items, tickets, and projects across the portfolio, following through to resolution and keeping clients updated on progress.
* Proactively identify and escalate delivery risks, service gaps, or blockers before they become client\-facing problems.

**Client Retention \& Growth**

* Monitor client satisfaction and health, proactively addressing risks to churn.
* Identify **upsell and cross\-sell opportunities** through a clear understanding of client goals, usage, and evolving needs.
* Partner with leadership, Client Success, and sales to price, pitch, and execute on new initiatives within existing accounts.

**Strategic Insight \& Planning**

* Track how each client’s business is evolving — org changes, growth, and shifting priorities — and share what it means for service alignment.
* Maintain a working knowledge of IT, cybersecurity, and compliance trends, especially as they relate to the startup and VC ecosystem.
* Contribute clean, well\-documented account notes and health metrics that feed Sentant’s broader Client Success strategy.

 **Ideal Candidate Profile**

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **2\+ years** in an Account Management, Client Success, project coordination, or similar client\-facing role — preferably at a **Managed Service Provider (MSP)** or in IT / Cyber / Compliance.
* Proven ability to manage **multiple concurrent client relationships or projects** without dropping details.
* Outstanding **organization, communication, and follow\-through** skills.
* Comfortable coordinating with technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders alike, and translating between them.
* A proactive, ownership\-driven mindset — you chase down answers and close loops without being asked.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to **MSP, IT service delivery, or cybersecurity** environments.
* Familiarity with startups, venture\-backed companies, and their operational lifecycles.
* Working familiarity with tools like Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace, or MDM/SSO systems.
* Comfort using metrics, reporting, and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot) to stay organized and inform client conversations.

 **Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Efficient, consistent, and well\-documented onboarding and deployment for every new client.
* High client satisfaction and strong retention across the portfolio.
* Clients who feel proactively managed — issues surfaced and resolved before they escalate.
* Growth in service utilization and project expansion within existing accounts.
* Clean account records, health metrics, and QBR materials that strengthen Sentant’s overall Client Success motion.

  


#### **Salary**


$60,000 \- $70,000 per year

**About BizzyCar**

  

BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. Our mission is to simplify car repairs, enabling consumers to resolve issues like recalls without leaving home or work. Through our automated platform, we streamline the process from manufacturers to dealers to customers, significantly reducing notification times and making repair scheduling seamless. Dealers benefit from increased repair revenue and strengthened customer relationships, while OEMs avoid costly fines.

  

We are solving a $22B industry challenge, with over 70 million cars on the road having unresolved recalls. BizzyCar is a fast\-paced, results\-driven company with an experienced leadership team skilled in building high\-value businesses. Employees enjoy competitive pay, equity opportunities, and medical benefits. While we’re a dispersed team, we prioritize collaboration and meet quarterly to maintain our strong culture.

 **About the role**

  

We're hiring a National Enterprise Account Manager to own the full lifecycle of our largest, most strategic national accounts. This role blends the relationship\-driven, retention\-focused mindset of a Customer Success Manager with the revenue\-driven, growth\-oriented instincts of an Account Executive. You'll be the primary point of contact for enterprise clients — responsible for keeping them happy, keeping them renewed, and identifying every opportunity to expand the partnership.

* Develop and maintain account plans that map out stakeholders, growth opportunities, risks, and renewal timelines
* Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) with key accounts to demonstrate value and align on future goals
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline data in CRM for renewals and expansion opportunities
* Provide market and account feedback to Product and Leadership to help shape roadmap and strategy

* 7\-10 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Enterprise Sales, supporting large/national accounts
* Proven experience managing or selling into national automotive dealership groups (e.g., Lithia Motors, Group 1 Automotive, AutoNation, Asbury Automotive, or similar) required
* Proven track record of managing renewals, driving expansion revenue, and independently signing new rooftops/locations within existing named accounts\-this role sells as much as it supports
* Strong consultative selling skills paired with genuine relationship\-building instincts
* Experience navigating complex organizations with multiple stakeholders and long sales/renewal cycles
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive presence
* CRM proficiency (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and comfort with pipeline forecasting
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time to meet with national account stakeholders and visit dealership rooftops

* **Comprehensive health benefits** — medical, dental, and vision coverage

jobs.title: Senior Amazon Marketing & Account Manager (Seller Central)
jobs.description:
**About Gravity Defyer**

Gravity Defyer is a direct\-to\-consumer footwear brand focused on medical and orthopedic footwear — shoes engineered for comfort, support, and everyday wear for people who need more from their footwear than the average brand delivers. We've built a loyal customer base through our own DTC channel, and Amazon is our next major growth engine.

We're looking for a proven Amazon expert to own the channel end to end — someone who has personally grown Amazon accounts, knows Seller Central inside and out, and treats our sales numbers like their own.

**The Role**

You will own Gravity Defyer's entire Amazon business: strategy, advertising, listings, brand content, inventory, account health, and P\&L. This is not a support role and not an agency\-coordination role — you are the operator. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do: **grow our Amazon sales and revenue profitably, starting in your first month, not after a long ramp\-up.**

You'll have real ownership, direct access to leadership, budget authority within agreed targets, and the freedom to run the channel the way a top\-tier Amazon operator would.

**Key ResponsibilitiesAccount Ownership \& Strategy**

* Own the complete Amazon Seller Central account (FBA and FBM) for the U.S. marketplace, with a roadmap to expand into Canada, UK/EU, and other marketplaces.
* Build and execute a 12\-month Amazon growth plan with clear revenue, margin, ranking, and market\-share targets.
* Own the Amazon P\&L: revenue, ad spend, FBA fees, storage, returns, and net contribution margin.
* Report weekly and monthly on performance, with clear insight into what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing.

**Amazon Advertising (PPC)**

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize all Amazon Ads campaigns: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP where appropriate.
* Manage the ad budget to hit TACoS/ACoS and total\-sales targets — scale what works, cut what doesn't.
* Run structured keyword research, campaign architecture, bid strategy, negative\-keyword management, dayparting, and placement optimization.
* Drive ranking strategy for our core keywords (e.g., orthopedic shoes, diabetic footwear, plantar fasciitis shoes, wide\-fit comfort shoes, medical footwear) and defend those rankings.

**Listing Optimization \& Brand Content**

* Own every product listing: titles, bullets, backend search terms, A\+ / Premium A\+ Content, images, video, and comparison charts.
* Build and maintain a best\-in\-class Amazon Brand Store.
* Manage variations (size/width/color), parent\-child structures, and catalog hygiene across a footwear catalog with a large SKU count.
* Run continuous conversion\-rate optimization: image testing, Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests), pricing tests, and review strategy.

**Reviews, Ratings \& Brand Protection**

* Drive review velocity through Amazon Vine, Request a Review, and compliant post\-purchase flows.
* Monitor and respond to reviews and customer questions; feed product insights back to the product team.
* Manage Brand Registry, Transparency, and IP protection — handle counterfeit listings, hijackers, and unauthorized sellers.

**Inventory, Operations \& Account Health**

* Own FBA inventory planning and forecasting across sizes and widths — avoid stockouts on winners and overstock on slow movers; manage IPI score, storage limits, and long\-term storage fees.
* Coordinate FBA shipments, prep requirements, labeling, and removals with our warehouse / 3PL.
* Keep account health in excellent standing: policy compliance, performance metrics, ODR, late shipment rate, and claims.
* Handle Seller Support cases, suspended ASINs, listing errors, and reinstatements quickly and effectively.
* Ensure listings comply with Amazon's requirements for medical / health\-related footwear claims.

**Promotions \& Events**

* Plan and execute Prime Day, Big Deal Days, Black Friday / Cyber Monday, and seasonal promotions: Lightning Deals, coupons, Subscribe \& Save, Prime Exclusive Discounts.
* Manage pricing strategy and Buy Box ownership across all SKUs.

**Analytics \& Growth**

* Use Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Product Opportunity Explorer, and third\-party tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, Pacvue/Perpetua, or similar) to find growth opportunities and measure results.
* Identify new product opportunities, bundles, and categories based on Amazon search data and competitor analysis.
* Align Amazon strategy with our DTC business — pricing parity, inventory allocation, and brand consistency.

**Requirements (Must\-Haves)**

* **Minimum 4\+ years of hands\-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing an account directly — not just overseeing an agency.
* **Proven track record of growing an Amazon account** to $10M\+ in annual revenue (or scaling one significantly), with results you can show and explain.
* **Proven ability to deliver fast results** — you can point to accounts where you drove a revenue increase within your first 30 days of taking over, and explain exactly how you did it.
* **Expert\-level Amazon PPC skills** — you have personally managed six\-figure\-plus annual ad budgets and can walk through your campaign structure and results.
* Deep, current knowledge of Amazon's algorithm, ranking factors, listing best practices, and policy landscape.
* Strong experience with FBA logistics, inventory forecasting, and account health management.
* Experience with Brand Registry, A\+ Content, Brand Store, and Amazon's brand tools.
* Highly analytical — comfortable living in spreadsheets and dashboards, and able to turn data into decisions.
* Proficiency with at least one leading Amazon toolset (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, Pacvue, Perpetua, or equivalent).
* Self\-directed, accountable, and results\-obsessed — you take ownership of the number.
* Excellent written communication (listings, A\+ content, internal reporting).

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience in **footwear

* Previous experience with MoneyGram products, POS systems, or financial institutions preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex financial issues.
* Experience with reconciliation processes, financial reporting, and settlement systems.

MoneyGram is a global payments network built to move money across borders with speed, simplicity and trust. Its omnichannel platform empowers consumers, developers and agents to transfer cash, fiat and stablecoin however it works best for them.

**Type:** Temporary, Non\-Exempt, Full\-time. This will be an approximately 9\-week program working 40 hours per week.


**Location:** San Francisco, CA. This is a hybrid role that is required to work in the office 2 days a week.


**Deadline:** Applications are due by Friday, September 18, 2026\.


**Start Date:** ASAP


**Reports to:** Eileen Ma, DNI Program Director


**Compensation:** This is a Temporary, Non\-Exempt, and Full\-time position. The hourly rate for this position is $34\.66 per hour.


**The Opportunity**


The individual in this role will provide support for and play a coordinating role for the ALC's Election Protection and other voting rights advocacy this fall. The Temporary Project Coordinator will handle administration and logistics for poll monitoring, including correspondence and management of volunteers, polling place assignments, and related components; track and provide support for partner organizations, complete data analysis and research assignments in support of DNI projects, and other admin and support roles related to ALC's democracy defense work. The Temporary Project Coordinator will work closely with DNI's Senior Project Coordinator and will be supervised by the DNI Director.

  

**The Organization**


ALC is the nation's first legal organization focusing on advancing and defending the civil rights of Asian and Pacific Islander (API) communities. Since 1972, ALC has fought for access to affordable housing in San Francisco's Chinatown, litigated high\-profile civil rights cases, advocated for the passage of landmark policy changes, and provided an array of services, including community education, advocacy, and direct client representation to further the rights of low\-income immigrants and communities of color, across our Housing Rights, Workers' Rights, Immigrant Justice, and National Democracy Initiative programs, and other emerging areas of law.


**Responsibilities**


Day\-to\-day activities include the following:


* Tracking and management of volunteer recruitment for poll monitoring program
* Correspondence and relationship management with volunteers
* Data analysis and research in support of polling place assignments
* Correspondence with and support for local and national partner organizations.
* Participation in local and statewide policy coalitions or convenings as needed.

City Wide Facility Solutions is the nation's leading management company in the building maintenance industry, providing facility solutions to commercial properties across the South Bay and Santa Cruz areas. We are seeking a detail\-oriented Night Quality Assurance Manager to join our team part\-time.


City Wide manages facility services through a network of Independent Contractors (ICs) — independent businesses that employ their own crews. As Night Quality Assurance Manager, you are City Wide's quality\-assurance and contract\-compliance representative in the field after hours. You visit client buildings on a nightly route, inspect completed work against each account's scope of work, document what you find, and communicate directly with the IC's owner or authorized representative so any deficiency gets corrected quickly. You are the reason our clients walk into a spotless facility every morning.


Two requirements are essential for this role:

* **Fully bilingual in English and Spanish.** This is a business necessity — you will communicate with Spanish\-speaking Independent Contractor representatives on site and report to English\-speaking clients and City Wide management on the same shift.
* **Hands\-on commercial janitorial knowledge.** You need to know the work, the chemicals, and the equipment well enough to evaluate whether it was performed to specification.

 **Schedule \& Pay**

* Approximately 20 hours per week, generally 4 hours a night, 5 nights a week (Monday–Friday) Flexible
* Flexible schedule — start times and route order are flexible and set collaboratively based on client access windows and your availability. Shifts typically begin between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM.
* Pay range: $30\.00 – $33\.00 per hour, depending on experience. This is the good\-faith pay scale for this position.
* Non\-exempt, hourly position. All hours worked are paid, including travel time between accounts during your shift. Paid rest periods are provided in accordance with California law.

 **What You'll Do**

* Conduct nightly quality\-assurance inspections of assigned buildings against each account's written specifications and scope of work
* Document inspection results, deficiencies, and completed corrections with notes and photos in the company CRM
* Communicate inspection findings and correction requests to the Independent Contractor's owner or designated representative — the IC is solely responsible for directing, scheduling, training, disciplining, and paying its own employees
* Verify that contracted deliverables were completed on schedule and to specification, and confirm follow\-up on any prior deficiency
* Report any issue requiring immediate attention to your Facility Solutions Manager the same night
* Provide feedback to City Wide management on IC performance to inform future work assignments
* Support new client onboarding, initial cleans, VIP requests, and client concerns
* Monitor supply levels, consumables, and equipment condition at assigned accounts and report needs
* Ensure City Wide's own compliance with client site access, safety, and security procedures
* Represent City Wide professionally on client property at all times

  

This position does not supervise, hire, schedule, discipline, or set the pay of any Independent Contractor's employees. Direction of IC personnel flows through the Independent Contractor.

 **Requirements** **Required**

* Bilingual — fluent in English and Spanish, spoken and written (business necessity, as described above)
* Hands\-on commercial janitorial experience — familiarity with floor care, restroom detail, day\-porter work, dilution ratios, autoscrubbers, burnishers, and commercial vacuums, sufficient to assess whether work meets specification
* Your own reliable transportation, a valid California driver's license, and current auto insurance meeting California minimums (driving between accounts is an essential function of this role)
* High school diploma or equivalent
* Comfortable using a smartphone or tablet for reporting and photo documentation
* Ability to work independently overnight with minimal oversight

 **Preferred**

* At least one year of supervisory or team\-lead experience
* Prior experience in facility services, building maintenance, or a similar inspection/compliance role
* Strong planning and organizational skills with a sharp eye for detail
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

 **Physical Requirements**


With or without reasonable accommodation, this role requires walking facilities for the duration of the shift, using stairs, occasionally lifting up to 25 lbs, and driving between multiple accounts during the shift. City Wide provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities; please let us know if you need one during the application process.

* Cell phone/data reimbursement
* Company\-provided tablet or reporting device
* Paid sick leave in accordance with California law

We are expanding in the South Bay and Santa Cruz markets, and this part\-time role is a genuine path to a full\-time Facility Solutions Manager position for the right person — full\-time team members are eligible for our medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and paid time off.

We're still just getting started.

new_jobs.title: ML Data Operations Lead, Dataset Release and Delivery - Autonomous Vehicles
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is redefining the automotive industry through accelerated computing, artificial intelligence, simulation, and full\-stack autonomous vehicle development. The pace and quality of AV development depend on delivering the right sensor, ground\-truth, and derived data to machine learning teams reliably, transparently, and at scale. It's truly the data that makes the cars drive!


The AV MLOps Dataset Release team transforms large\-scale automotive data into versioned, trustworthy datasets used to train and evaluate machine learning models across the autonomous\-driving stack. We are seeking an ML Data Operations Lead to own the customer\-facing operational lifecycle of these releases. In this role, you will work at the intersection of machine learning, data engineering, infrastructure, and release operations. You will partner with ML engineers to understand their data needs, translate those needs into actionable release requirements, coordinate execution with the engineering team, and ensure every release is delivered with clear validation, documentation, and communication. This is a senior individual\-contributor role. It requires sufficient technical depth to investigate problems, assess delivery risk, and challenge unclear requirements, while focusing primarily on operational ownership rather than developing the underlying data pipelines.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Serve as the primary operational partner for ML engineers and other internal consumers of AV datasets.
* Capture and clarify dataset release requirements, including intended use cases, required signals and labels, data volumes, release cadence, delivery timelines, storage destinations, and acceptance criteria.
* Be responsible for the release calendar and coordinate priorities, dependencies, engineering readiness, and compute capacity across multiple concurrent dataset\-release tracks.
* Monitor production release workflows from launch through delivery. Identify failures, stalled tasks, resource constraints, missing data, and other risks, then bring together the appropriate engineers and infrastructure owners to drive resolution.
* Validate release results against expected volumes, signals, versions, and quality criteria before communicating availability to customers.
* Maintain timely, accurate communication with customers regarding release status, risks, incidents, changing estimates, and recovery plans.
* Produce release notes, delivery announcements, known\-issue documentation, and handoff information that enable ML teams to understand and use each dataset confidently.

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6\+ years of experience in ML data operations, technical service delivery, dataset operations, release operations, technical program execution, or another data\-intensive operational role.
* Solid understanding of the machine learning data lifecycle, including data collection, curation, labeling, validation, versioning, release, storage, and consumption by training or evaluation pipelines.
* Ability to use SQL and data\-analysis tools to investigate dataset contents, reconcile expected and delivered results, and identify quality or completeness issues.
* Strong customer orientation and skill in translating between ML engineers, data specialists, infrastructure teams, and other technical collaborators.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce detailed requirements, release notes, status updates, incident summaries, and operating procedures.
* Excellent judgment when balancing customer timelines, engineering capacity, system reliability, data quality, and competing release priorities.
* Proven track record of influencing without direct authority and driving work to completion across a highly matrixed organization.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-moving environment where requirements, data availability, and technical constraints may change quickly.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience operating large\-scale dataset generation, materialization, validation, or delivery workflows, especially for autonomous\-driving, ADAS, robotics, or computer\-vision systems.
* Familiarity with automotive sensor and ground\-truth data, including camera, lidar, radar, mapping, calibration, or multimodal datasets.
* Hands\-on experience with Python, notebooks, Databricks, dashboards, or lightweight automation used to investigate data and improve operational workflows.
* Experience defining service\-level objectives, operational metrics, alerting, incident\-management practices, and root\-cause corrective actions.
* A track record of converting frequently repeated customer requests or operational problems into standardized, automated, and scalable services.

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

  

We're looking for a Program Manager to own and operate a centralized intake process for a fast\-moving, cross\-functional organization. This role sits at the center of how work enters and exits the function \- triaging requests, setting intake standards, and ensuring only clean, well\-scoped work moves downstream. It's a high\-visibility, relationship\-driven role where success depends on influence and trust\-building rather than formal authority, and where a true white\-glove, end\-to\-end approach to every request is expected.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own and operate a single, unified intake point for all incoming requests, initiative submissions, and cross\-functional asks
* Drive alignment across sub\-functions to consolidate fragmented intake processes into one unified system, building trust and demonstrating value along the way
* Triage and qualify every inbound submission, flag duplicates and gaps, and package well\-scoped submissions for hand\-off to the planning function
* Define and maintain intake standards, SLAs, and qualification criteria to ensure consistently clean, decision\-ready submissions
* Own the outbound submission process to other teams — submitting, tracking, and following through from request to resolution
* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner with key partner teams, maintaining those relationships over time
* Track status and commitments on every outbound ask, escalate stalled requests, and maintain a clear, current view for leadership
* Build and maintain reporting on intake volume, request types, turnaround time, and bottlenecks
* Continuously improve the intake operating model as the organization's footprint and cross\-functional surface area grows

**Qualifications**


*Required:*


* 6\-8\+ years of experience in program management, business operations, or a highly cross\-functional intake/operations role
* Demonstrated ability to build alignment and drive process change without formal authority, relying on trust and credibility
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining intake, triage, or workflow systems (e.g., Airtable, Asana, Jira, or similar)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with volume, throughput, and SLA data to surface patterns and process gaps
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi\-phase work\-streams with competing deadlines and multiple stakeholder groups
* Strong proficiency with Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides), including templates and lightweight automation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill high\-volume inputs into clear, exec\-ready materials
* Highly organized self\-starter with a strong bias toward documentation and structured process
* A true white\-glove approach to service and relationship management, end to end
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience

*Preferred:*


* Comfort with multi\-level tracking, field logic, and reporting views within workflow tools

**Key Details**


* Start Date: Late September, 2026
* Duration: Approximately 6 months (through March, 2027\)
* Location: Remote (within the U.S.)
* Work Schedule: Full\-time, 40 hours/week, Monday\-Friday
* Pay Rate: $102\-$117/hour \+ benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k)
* Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* Engagement: W2 Contract role through Maleda Tech.

new_jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About VALD**


VALD is the world leader in technology for the allied health industry, providing innovative human\-measurement technology to over 15,000 clients in over 150 countries. If you have a favorite team in the NBA, EPL, or NFL, there's a good chance they use VALD Technologies.


Since its humble beginnings in 2015 in Brisbane, Australia, VALD has grown to a team of over 400 team members in over 30 countries, with 5 offices across four continents.  

  

Driven by a multidisciplinary team of researchers, clinicians, sports scientists, designers, developers and engineers, VALD's suite of systems offer unparalleled insight into human movement, performance, injury risk and rehabilitation.


**About the Role:**


The **Sales** Operations Manager plays a critical role in keeping daily operations moving smoothly across sales, events, marketing, logistics, and leadership teams. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys connecting people, bringing structure to busy environments, and making sure projects do not fall through the cracks. You will support and improve internal processes, coordinate cross\-functional projects, manage follow\-ups, and help create clear workflows that make the team more efficient.


The ideal person is proactive, organised, commercially aware, and comfortable taking ownership from idea to execution.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Sales \& CRM Support:** Support sales operations by maintaining accurate trackers, working with CRM systems such as HubSpot, updating opportunity or activity data, preparing sales reports, and helping teams follow consistent processes.
* **Process Ownership:** Build, document, and improve operational processes that create structure, accountability, and clear flow across teams. This includes developing checklists, templates, trackers, and standard operating procedures.
* **Event, Travel \& Logistics Coordination:** Coordinate conferences, workshops, travel, accommodation, shipments, inventory, merchandise, and event resources across multiple regions, ensuring deadlines, budgets, and stakeholder needs are managed clearly.
* **Reporting \& Data Analysis:** Use Excel and internal reporting tools to collect, organise, and analyse operational data, track KPIs, identify discrepancies, and provide insights that support decision\-making across regions.
* **Project Coordination \&** Problem\-Solving: Take ownership of projects from planning through delivery, keeping timelines, stakeholders, documentation, and next steps organised. Proactively identify what is missing and drive progress without waiting to be told every next step.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Act as a people\-focused connector between sales, marketing, operations, leadership, and external partners. Build strong working relationships, align stakeholders, and communicate clearly across time zones and cultures.
* **Administrative \& Leadership Support:** Prepare meeting recaps, presentations, project updates, hiring support documents, budget summaries, and other materials that help managers and regional teams stay aligned.


**Is this you?**


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**


To excel in the role of Operations Coordinator, key qualifications include:


* Strong proficiency in Excel, Microsoft Office, and CRM systems; experience with HubSpot is required.
* Previous experience in sales, sales support, operations, events, or a similarly fast\-paced coordination role.
* A genuine “people person” who enjoys building relationships, chasing follow\-ups professionally, and working with different personalities across teams.
* Strong project ownership, initiative, and follow\-through, with the ability to turn unclear needs into practical steps, processes, and deliverables.
* Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail when managing documents, spreadsheets, schedules, budgets, event logistics, and stakeholder communications.
* Analytical thinking and confidence working with data to identify discrepancies, track performance, and support practical decision\-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to write clear recaps, updates, reports, and internal documentation.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly and solutions need to be practical, clear, and fast.
* Relevant education is desired but not mandatory; business, operations, sales, events, or project\-management studies are advantageous. Experi

**Additional Information:**


* The position is fully remote, with a strong preference for candidates in the central time zone, though other parts of California will also be considered.
* The role may involve occasional travel for conferences, courses, or other company events.


If you are ready to take on a diverse, impactful role in a forward\-thinking company, this could be the opportunity for you. At VALD, we value adaptability, teamwork, and an eagerness to help drive operational success.

  

**VALD Diversity \& Inclusion Commitment**

VALD's best asset is not our technology but our people and culture. A culture of inclusion and diversity is critical to our business. We know diverse teams perform better. It's not a separate initiative – we aim to embed inclusion and diversity in everything we do. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and embracing diversity, including gender, nationality, disability, age, marital/parental status, ethnicity, gender identity, socioeconomic background and sexual orientation. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds.

**Description**


Job Posting Title Project Manager II/Patient Insights Ops Manager
Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.


Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.


Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.


Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

**WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE**


Why Syneos Health

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Project Leadership and Delivery. Manages a project as a project manager overseeing interdisciplinary clinical research studies and ensures compliance with GCP, relevant SOP’s, and regulatory requirements.
* Acts as a primary liaison between the Company and the Customer to ensure timely study launch, conduct, and closeout according to the Customer’s and the Company’s contractual agreement.
* Lead project team to ensure quality, timelines and budget management.
* Accountable for the financial performance of each project. Coordinate activities and deliverables of all study conduct partners and proactively identify and manage issues.
* Ensure studies are conducted in compliance with GCP, relevant SOP’s and regulatory requirements. Accountable for all project deliverables for each project assigned.
* Responsible for quality and completeness of TMF for assigned projects.
* Accountable for maintenance of study information on a variety of databases and systems.
* Responsible for study management components of inspection readiness for all aspects of the study conduct. Oversight for development and implementation of project plans.
* Plan, coordinate and present at internal and external meetings. Prepare project management reports for clients and management.
* Developing contingency planning and risk mitigation strategies to ensure successful delivery of study goals.
* Develops strong relationships with current clients to generate new and/or add\-on business for the future.
* May participate in bid defense meetings where presented as potential project manager.
* May be required to line manage other project management team members and clinical monitoring staff.


Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) level of qualification in life sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Clinical research organization (CRO) and relevant therapeutic experience preferred. Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
* Strong organizational skills.
* Strong ability to manage time and work independently.
* Direct therapeutic area expertise.
* Ability to embrace new technologies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken.
* Ability to travel as necessary (approximately 25%).


We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a \[possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.


Salary Range:


The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

new_jobs.title: Affiliate Marketing Project Manager / Executive Admin
new_jobs.description:
About Clutch Affiliate

Clutch Affiliate is a women\-owned affiliate and partnership marketing agency working with CPG and DTC brands across Amazon, DTC/network affiliate, publisher affiliate, TikTok Shop, and PR affiliate. With remote offices in Tampa, Florida and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, we run lean and move fast, both with our clients and with each other. If you like clear ownership over your work and don't want corporate red tape, you'll fit in here.

The Role

We're looking for a Project Manager / Admin who can be the connective tissue across Clutch. This role oversees the moving pieces across our full client roster and supports our co\-founders directly, keeping projects, deadlines, and next steps on track internally and with clients. You'll need to be organized, proactive, and comfortable owning the details other people forget to track.

This is not primarily an affiliate marketing execution role. Affiliate marketing knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement, we're happy to train that piece. What matters most is that you're a sharp project manager and administrator who can keep multiple clients and workstreams moving without being told twice.

We're not currently tied to a specific project management platform. If you have strong experience with a PM tool you love (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Notion, or otherwise) and think it would serve us well, we're genuinely open to adopting it.

If it's a mutual fit, there's real room to grow into full\-time as our client base expands.

What You'll Do

\- Serve as the central point of organization across all client accounts, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and next steps

\- Provide direct administrative support to Clutch's co\-founders, managing schedules, priorities, and follow\-through

\- Keep internal projects on track, flagging what's falling behind before it becomes a problem

\- Coordinate across the team to make sure client needs are being met on time

\- Build and maintain systems (trackers, checklists, calendars) that keep the agency organized as it scales

\- Sit in on client calls as needed to capture next steps and keep projects moving

\- Support affiliate program operations where needed (we'll train you on this as it comes up)

\- Bring ideas to the table on how to make Clutch run more efficiently, not just execute on someone else's

What You Need

\- Strong project management skills, comfortable juggling multiple clients and priorities at once

\- Excellent organizational skills and follow\-through, nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

\- Comfortable providing high\-level administrative support to founders

\- Self\-starter energy. We're not going to micromanage you; we need someone who sees what needs doing and does it

\- Clear, confident communicator, both internally and with clients

\- Genuine interest in helping a small agency run well and grow

Nice to Have

\- Familiarity with affiliate/publisher marketing (CJ, Avantlink, AWIN, or Impact)

\- PR affiliate experience

\- Experience with a PM platform you'd advocate for us adopting

Hours and Structure

Flexible and remote. Potential to expand to full\-time based on performance and agency growth.

Pay

Hourly, based on experience.

To Apply

To help us see who reads instructions carefully, please include the following when you apply:

1\. In your cover letter or application message, name one podcast episode Clutch Affiliate has appeared on (you'll find this on our website at www.clutchaffiliate.com).

2\. Include the phrase "Growth Partner" somewhere in your subject line or application message.

Applications that skip these steps will not be considered.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

 **About this Position**


The Sage X3 Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Sage Intacct implementations for Net at Work clients. This role centers around client excellence, building trusted partnerships, maintaining high satisfaction levels, and driving long\-term value.

  

The PM works directly with clients to clarify business requirements, propose scalable solutions, and ensure smooth implementation. They serve as the key liaison between clients and internal teams, leveraging strong communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills. The PM also supports the sales team by contributing to project scoping and helping to expand client relationships through ongoing service opportunities.

 **Job Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship Management \& Client Excellence*** Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with client stakeholders to ensure satisfaction and foster ongoing engagement.
* Proactively manage client communications, providing strategic updates and anticipating needs to drive a positive experience.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to align project execution with client goals, ensuring outcomes meet or exceed expectations.
* Ensure a smooth transition to post\-implementation support, maintaining continuity and client confidence.
* Identify and surface opportunities for additional services or solutions that support client success and contribute to account growth.

 **Project Planning \& Initiation*** Develop comprehensive project plans outlining timelines, milestones, budgets, deliverables, and resource requirements.
* Lead team onboarding activities to ensure alignment and readiness for successful project execution.
* Distribute pre\-kickoff materials and onboarding documentation to set clear project engagement expectations.
* Facilitate internal and client\-facing kickoff meetings to establish shared goals, roles, and success criteria.

 **Project Execution \& Coordination*** Lead project execution in alignment with defined scope, timelines, and budgets.
* Assign and coordinate tasks across cross\-functional teams to ensure timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Review and approve project time entries to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Oversee project financials, including revenue recognition and budget tracking.
* Facilitate the discovery, scoping, development, and delivery of change requests.
* Monitor project progress and proactively adjust plans to meet client expectations.
* Track key milestones and timelines, reallocating resources and adjusting workflows as needed.
* Manage third\-party project deliverables and follow up to ensure timely closure.

 **Client \& Stakeholder Communication*** Serve as the primary liaison for all internal and external project stakeholders, ensuring clear and consistent communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead regular project status meetings, tailoring cadence and format to project size and complexity.
* Distribute weekly status summaries, meeting recaps, and recordings, and maintain organized documentation within the designated project folder.

As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross\-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.


Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management's strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

* **Project \& Timeline Management:** Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.

Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
* **Advanced Risk Management:** Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
* Typically 7–10\+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

**Management Skills**

* **Detail‑Oriented:** Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
* **Communication:** Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.

* **Cross‑Functional Fluency:** Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
* **Adaptability \& Ambiguity:** Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Mediator, not Participant:** Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.

Sentant is seeking a driven and highly organized Account Manager to own the full client lifecycle — from onboarding and deployment through ongoing relationship management, retention, and growth. This role is the day\-to\-day owner of a portfolio of client accounts and the connective tissue between our clients and Sentant’s internal service teams.


### **About Sentant, LLC**


We specialize in providing comprehensive managed services that enhance your IT infrastructure, ensure compliance, and bolster security.
### **Description**


Sentant is seeking a driven and highly organized **Account Manager** to own the full client lifecycle — from onboarding and deployment through ongoing relationship management, retention, and growth. This role is the day\-to\-day owner of a portfolio of client accounts and the connective tissue between our clients and Sentant’s internal service teams.

  

The Account Manager is the hands\-on operator who makes that strategy real: standing up new clients cleanly, keeping delivery on track, and building trusted relationships that turn clients into long\-term partners. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-obsessed, and thrives in a fast\-moving, client\-facing environment.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Onboarding \& Deployment**

* Own the **end\-to\-end client onboarding process**: kickoff calls, documentation, timelines, internal coordination, and clear expectation setting.
* Drive **deployment of new clients** onto Sentant’s tools, processes, and communication channels, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks during the transition from sales to service.
* Coordinate closely with engineering, security, and helpdesk teams to stand up client environments accurately and on schedule.
* Create and maintain onboarding documentation and account records so every client starts with a clean, well\-organized foundation.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Serve as the **primary day\-to\-day point of contact** for a portfolio of clients post\-sale.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders, ensuring they feel supported, informed, and understood.
* Conduct regular client check\-ins to stay aligned on goals, priorities, and pain points, and to keep service delivery on track.
* Support and help deliver **Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)**, preparing materials that surface insights, service value, and opportunities.

**Service Delivery \& Coordination**

* Act as the client’s advocate internally, translating client needs into clear actions for Sentant’s technical and operational teams.
* Track open items, tickets, and projects across the portfolio, following through to resolution and keeping clients updated on progress.
* Proactively identify and escalate delivery risks, service gaps, or blockers before they become client\-facing problems.

**Client Retention \& Growth**

* Monitor client satisfaction and health, proactively addressing risks to churn.
* Identify **upsell and cross\-sell opportunities** through a clear understanding of client goals, usage, and evolving needs.
* Partner with leadership, Client Success, and sales to price, pitch, and execute on new initiatives within existing accounts.

**Strategic Insight \& Planning**

* Track how each client’s business is evolving — org changes, growth, and shifting priorities — and share what it means for service alignment.
* Maintain a working knowledge of IT, cybersecurity, and compliance trends, especially as they relate to the startup and VC ecosystem.
* Contribute clean, well\-documented account notes and health metrics that feed Sentant’s broader Client Success strategy.

 **Ideal Candidate Profile**

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **2\+ years** in an Account Management, Client Success, project coordination, or similar client\-facing role — preferably at a **Managed Service Provider (MSP)** or in IT / Cyber / Compliance.
* Proven ability to manage **multiple concurrent client relationships or projects** without dropping details.
* Outstanding **organization, communication, and follow\-through** skills.
* Comfortable coordinating with technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders alike, and translating between them.
* A proactive, ownership\-driven mindset — you chase down answers and close loops without being asked.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to **MSP, IT service delivery, or cybersecurity** environments.
* Familiarity with startups, venture\-backed companies, and their operational lifecycles.
* Working familiarity with tools like Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace, or MDM/SSO systems.
* Comfort using metrics, reporting, and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot) to stay organized and inform client conversations.

 **Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Efficient, consistent, and well\-documented onboarding and deployment for every new client.
* High client satisfaction and strong retention across the portfolio.
* Clients who feel proactively managed — issues surfaced and resolved before they escalate.
* Growth in service utilization and project expansion within existing accounts.
* Clean account records, health metrics, and QBR materials that strengthen Sentant’s overall Client Success motion.

  


#### **Salary**


$60,000 \- $70,000 per year

new_jobs.title: Senior Amazon Marketing & Account Manager (Seller Central)
new_jobs.description:
**About Gravity Defyer**

Gravity Defyer is a direct\-to\-consumer footwear brand focused on medical and orthopedic footwear — shoes engineered for comfort, support, and everyday wear for people who need more from their footwear than the average brand delivers. We've built a loyal customer base through our own DTC channel, and Amazon is our next major growth engine.

We're looking for a proven Amazon expert to own the channel end to end — someone who has personally grown Amazon accounts, knows Seller Central inside and out, and treats our sales numbers like their own.

**The Role**

You will own Gravity Defyer's entire Amazon business: strategy, advertising, listings, brand content, inventory, account health, and P\&L. This is not a support role and not an agency\-coordination role — you are the operator. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do: **grow our Amazon sales and revenue profitably, starting in your first month, not after a long ramp\-up.**

You'll have real ownership, direct access to leadership, budget authority within agreed targets, and the freedom to run the channel the way a top\-tier Amazon operator would.

**Key ResponsibilitiesAccount Ownership \& Strategy**

* Own the complete Amazon Seller Central account (FBA and FBM) for the U.S. marketplace, with a roadmap to expand into Canada, UK/EU, and other marketplaces.
* Build and execute a 12\-month Amazon growth plan with clear revenue, margin, ranking, and market\-share targets.
* Own the Amazon P\&L: revenue, ad spend, FBA fees, storage, returns, and net contribution margin.
* Report weekly and monthly on performance, with clear insight into what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing.

**Amazon Advertising (PPC)**

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize all Amazon Ads campaigns: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP where appropriate.
* Manage the ad budget to hit TACoS/ACoS and total\-sales targets — scale what works, cut what doesn't.
* Run structured keyword research, campaign architecture, bid strategy, negative\-keyword management, dayparting, and placement optimization.
* Drive ranking strategy for our core keywords (e.g., orthopedic shoes, diabetic footwear, plantar fasciitis shoes, wide\-fit comfort shoes, medical footwear) and defend those rankings.

**Listing Optimization \& Brand Content**

* Own every product listing: titles, bullets, backend search terms, A\+ / Premium A\+ Content, images, video, and comparison charts.
* Build and maintain a best\-in\-class Amazon Brand Store.
* Manage variations (size/width/color), parent\-child structures, and catalog hygiene across a footwear catalog with a large SKU count.
* Run continuous conversion\-rate optimization: image testing, Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests), pricing tests, and review strategy.

**Reviews, Ratings \& Brand Protection**

* Drive review velocity through Amazon Vine, Request a Review, and compliant post\-purchase flows.
* Monitor and respond to reviews and customer questions; feed product insights back to the product team.
* Manage Brand Registry, Transparency, and IP protection — handle counterfeit listings, hijackers, and unauthorized sellers.

**Inventory, Operations \& Account Health**

* Own FBA inventory planning and forecasting across sizes and widths — avoid stockouts on winners and overstock on slow movers; manage IPI score, storage limits, and long\-term storage fees.
* Coordinate FBA shipments, prep requirements, labeling, and removals with our warehouse / 3PL.
* Keep account health in excellent standing: policy compliance, performance metrics, ODR, late shipment rate, and claims.
* Handle Seller Support cases, suspended ASINs, listing errors, and reinstatements quickly and effectively.
* Ensure listings comply with Amazon's requirements for medical / health\-related footwear claims.

**Promotions \& Events**

* Plan and execute Prime Day, Big Deal Days, Black Friday / Cyber Monday, and seasonal promotions: Lightning Deals, coupons, Subscribe \& Save, Prime Exclusive Discounts.
* Manage pricing strategy and Buy Box ownership across all SKUs.

**Analytics \& Growth**

* Use Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Product Opportunity Explorer, and third\-party tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, Pacvue/Perpetua, or similar) to find growth opportunities and measure results.
* Identify new product opportunities, bundles, and categories based on Amazon search data and competitor analysis.
* Align Amazon strategy with our DTC business — pricing parity, inventory allocation, and brand consistency.

**Requirements (Must\-Haves)**

* **Minimum 4\+ years of hands\-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing an account directly — not just overseeing an agency.
* **Proven track record of growing an Amazon account** to $10M\+ in annual revenue (or scaling one significantly), with results you can show and explain.
* **Proven ability to deliver fast results** — you can point to accounts where you drove a revenue increase within your first 30 days of taking over, and explain exactly how you did it.
* **Expert\-level Amazon PPC skills** — you have personally managed six\-figure\-plus annual ad budgets and can walk through your campaign structure and results.
* Deep, current knowledge of Amazon's algorithm, ranking factors, listing best practices, and policy landscape.
* Strong experience with FBA logistics, inventory forecasting, and account health management.
* Experience with Brand Registry, A\+ Content, Brand Store, and Amazon's brand tools.
* Highly analytical — comfortable living in spreadsheets and dashboards, and able to turn data into decisions.
* Proficiency with at least one leading Amazon toolset (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, Pacvue, Perpetua, or equivalent).
* Self\-directed, accountable, and results\-obsessed — you take ownership of the number.
* Excellent written communication (listings, A\+ content, internal reporting).

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience in **footwear
